// /dev has real device nodes.
$ ls -l /dev/null /dev/urandom /dev/mtdblock4 | cat
brw-------    1 root     root       31,    4 Oct  3 15:42 /dev/mtdblock4
crw-rw-rw-    1 root     root        1,    3 Oct  3 15:42 /dev/null
crw-rw-rw-    1 root     root        1,    9 Oct  3 15:42 /dev/urandom
$ head -c 16 /dev/urandom | wc -c; head -c 5 /dev/zero | wc -c; echo hi > /dev/null; cat /dev/null | wc -c
16
5
0
$ cp /dev/null /tmp/empty; ls -l /tmp/empty | cat
-rw-r--r--    1 root     root             0 Nov 17 20:00 /tmp/empty

// Programs are full size; /dev/urandom never ends.
$ wc -c /bin/busybox /app/ipcam | head -2; grep -c 'multi-call binary' /bin/busybox; md5sum /bin/busybox | cut -c1-8; md5sum /bin/ls | cut -c1-8
